tableLines.line: ⛓️ Emberhold doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Pavel speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A man, maybe 40s, with thick glasses: "broad oval ribbed leaves flat to ground, tall thin seed spikes is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
A person, maybe 30s: "a plant with jagged leaves and a yellow flower is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
Mateo wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what Pavel said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Rosa.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Mateo: "Mahua is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
